description: OpenCode V2 server plugin: when a subscription provider's usage limit is hit, move every agent, the default model and the active session to its fallback, probe the plan once every five minutes (one request per process) and come back as soon as it answers

detail.description_zh: OpenCode V2 服务器插件：当订阅提供商的使用限制达到时，将每个代理、默认模型和活动会话移至其备用选项，每五分钟探测一次计划（每个进程一次请求），并在其回应后立即返回
